name: address_rule
description: What a player types as a server address in the Join panel becomes the server's URL by the address rule: a private address (192.168.1.20, the shared 100.64/10) means a server on this network, ws://<address>:8766/causeway, and the strip says LAN; a name online becomes wss://<name>/causeway, and the strip says Online.

steps.msg: 192.168.1.20: ws, the port and the path
100.64.1.2 (a VPN's shared space) is on this network too
a name online: wss and the path
typed 192.168.1.20: the game connects to ws://192.168.1.20:8766/causeway, on the LAN
the strip: LAN, the address as typed, and the party's code

steps.assert: Session.client.link.url == 'wss://play.example.org/causeway' and Session.where == 'online' and Session.place_text() == 'Online · play.example.org'
not Session.connect_to('not an address!') and Session.last_notice == 'Not a server address: not an address!'
steps.msg: a typed address that is none says so
